record_type_quote: As of 8/11/2021, stage 1 data collection has been completed, and the stage 1 analytic sample size was met (275 participants after exclusions) Since the analysis at Stage 1 was significant, Stage 2 is not required.

targets.evidence_quote: Claim for Review – The claim selected was that the likelihood of purchasing counterfeit luxury brands is greater when consumer attitudes toward luxury brands serve a social-adjustive function than when their attitudes serve a value-expressive function.
targets.outcome_quote: H* was supported. In addition, the pattern of means was directionally consistent with the pattern in the paper.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit support for the focal hypothesis and agreement with original means.
